subject: Coordinate demo deep-dive and evaluation kickoff — proposed timeline

Subject: Coordinate demo deep-dive and evaluation kickoff — proposed timeline

Hi Samira —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step so we can lock the evaluation kickoff (technical deep-dive + trial plan).

Recap:
- Primary use case: automated triage + clinical summarization for urgent care triage.
- Success criteria you called out: >=85% precision on triage labels, <250ms median latency for 1–2k token workflows, and stable hallucination rate on the prompt set.
- Security: you mentioned SOC 2 and a short evidence packet — we can surface that in the kickoff.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff that includes: 25m technical deep-dive (model variants, inference latency/quantization tradeoffs), 25m trial plan walk-through (MTP + success metrics), 10–15m prompt/initial eval set review and immediate next steps.

Suggested calendar slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 23, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Jun 24, 14:00–15:15
- Thu Jun 25, 09:00–10:15

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll get something on the calendar. I’ve attached a very short mutual trial plan (MTP) draft and a starter prompt example spreadsheet so you can see the level of detail we typically evaluate.

Attachments: MTP_Draft.pdf (PDF, stub), prompt_examples_v1.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—Jonas
